summary: Fixes Branding-modal system-name edits, adds a reliable Celery-beat trigger for the daily update check, and locks the update progress dialog while a run is in flight. Inline-safe; no migration.
highlights: Branding-modal system names now synchronize into the saved SystemSettings value.
The daily update check now runs on a reliable Celery-beat schedule that survives updater-worker restarts.
The update progress dialog can no longer be dismissed while an inline update is running.
